_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 59 (Bruh Star Navicus) — a design detour: a NEW 'TMC Builder' tab. Pick your College + a Transfer Model Curriculum (ADT) at the top; the LEFT column is the fixed, ASCCC-defined C-ID course list (Required Core / List A/B/C), and the RIGHT column is a dropdown of YOUR college's own COCI courses — auto-filling the course that already carries each C-ID. It totals your units, saves to Supabase so you can resume, and exports a Word/PDF/JSON of the completed form. Shipped with 8 DRAFT TMCs (Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Communication, History, Business Admin, Math, Biology) — the slot C-IDs are real but section/unit details need a faculty pass, and the other ~37 TMCs still need adding. Hard-refresh, open 'TMC Builder', try your college. The data lane (Suggested-merges + the Jaccard) is paused but intact — see docs/session_59_handoff.md.

items.text: NEW tab → 'TMC Builder'. Pick a college + a TMC; the right side auto-fills your courses that already carry each C-ID, totals the units, and exports a Word/PDF you could submit. Try a few colleges + disciplines and tell me what feels off — especially whether the 8 seed TMCs' Required Core / List A-B-C groupings + unit ranges match the official templates (they need a faculty verify).

If you can drop me the official TMC template PDFs (or a link I can reach), I'll encode all ~45 authoritatively. Also note: ~1/4 of colleges (incl. Riverside) report few C-IDs in the COCI extract, so their auto-match is sparse — they pick from the dropdown.

✨ Suggested merges (data lane, still live): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet) — divider words AND abbreviations fold. Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add more courses by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, and a 'Completion note' box.

Still queued: the 🏷 title-similarity lane (~5,457 groups). Say the word and Fable DRY-RUNs a high-cosine, cross-college, band-gated pass 2 (reversible, marker automerge-titlelane-v1) for your review before anything applies.
